(b64/decode \"Zg== \")) \"trailing whitespace is rejected\")\n    (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zg=\")) \"padding must complete a four-character quantum\")\n    (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zg===\")) \"excess padding is rejected\")\n    (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Z=g=\")) \"padding in the middle is rejected\")\n    (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zh==\")) \"non-zero trailing bits in a two-character tail are rejected\")\n    (assert (err? (b64/decode \"Zm9=\")) \"non-zero trailing bits in a three-character tail are rejected\")\n    (assert (err? (b64/decodeUrlSafe \"A\")) \"URL-safe decoder validates length\")\n    (assert (err? (b64/decodeUrlSafe \"Zg=\")) \"URL-safe decoder validates padding\")\n    true))\n\nfn runTests -> Bool\n  (and (testRfc4648Vectors)\n    (and (testUrlSafe)\n      (and (testUrlSafePadding) (testMalformed))))\n")
```
(module asl-text/base64
  :x [encode encodeNoPad encodeUrlSafe encodeUrlSafePad decode decodeUrlSafe]
  :i [])

fn stdAlpha -> String
  "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

fn urlAlpha -> String
  "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_"

fn b64Char alpha: String v: Int64 -> String
  (optionOr (stringSlice alpha v (+ v 1)) "")

fn addPadding s: String -> String
  (let [(r (mod (stringLength s) 4))]
    (if (= r 2)
      (str s "==")
      (if (= r 3) (str s "=") s)))

fn encLoop bytes: Bytes alpha: String i: Int64 n: Int64 acc: String -> String
  (if (>= i n)
    acc
    (let [(rem (- n i))
          (b0 (bytesGet bytes i))
          (b1 (if (< (+ i 1) n) (bytesGet bytes (+ i 1)) 0))
          (b2 (if (< (+ i 2) n) (bytesGet bytes (+ i 2)) 0))
          (v0 (/ b0 4))
          (v1 (+ (* (mod b0 4) 16) (/ b1 16)))
          (v2 (+ (* (mod b1 16) 4) (/ b2 64)))
          (v3 (mod b2 64))]
      (encLoop bytes alpha (+ i 3) n
        (str acc
          (b64Char alpha v0)
          (b64Char alpha v1)
          (if (> rem 1) (b64Char alpha v2) "")
          (if (> rem 2) (b64Char alpha v3) ""))))) :rawFields "content")
